title: 第389章 百兽议事与混沌封印第388章 师尊对师尊与石青璇的抉择
lines: 次日正午。盆地中央的巨岩上。
百兽禁地所有核心神兽齐至。
巨岩本身不是普通的岩石，是一块通体墨绿的远古陨星碎片——多年前荒古大战时被从碎裂的星核上削下半片砸在这片盆地中央，此后便成了神兽们议事时默认的聚集台。
石面上的纹路是陨星原始的星核留痕，在正午日光的直射下会自行发出极淡的浅绿色荧光。
青冥老龙从东面无名湖泊中浮出，这次不是只露一块背鳞或一只龙角，是完整的真身破水而出。
它的体长几乎与虚空裂谷的宽度相当，通体青鳞在日光下泛出层层叠叠的深浅不同的青碧光辉。
它的龙角已经纵向分化了两次——那是龙族年纪极其古老的标志。
它盘踞在巨岩最东侧的半空位置，龙首微微低垂，一对比屋子还大的龙目半开半合地俯视全场。
白鹿灵尊从竹林中信步走出来，鹿角上那几颗月光露的果核在正午日光下几乎隐形。
它选了巨岩左侧一块平坦台檐卧下，姿势自如得像在自己家里午休。
金翅大鹏从高空收翼落下，落在巨岩最高处一截天然凸起的陨铁尖顶上，大翅微张，目光扫过在场每一只神兽。
玄武后裔从空地中央睡处缓缓爬上来，龟甲上的那片微型草原在移动过程中有数只不知所措的小灵雀从草丛中惊飞起来绕了一圈又落回草上。
还有几只新神兽——一匹体型偏小但气息极为锐利的年轻麒麟，它还没成年，角只有半截，周身鳞甲在日光下泛着青玉色；
一只生着赤红羽冠的巨鹤蹲在巨岩边缘，单腿站着，姿态极为优雅但半眯着眼，像是随时会打瞌睡；
还有之前见过的独角兽、白灵狐、还有一些栖息在百兽禁地深处平日里极少外出的神禽与走兽。总共来了二十多只成年神兽——全部金仙级以上。
其中最强的是青冥老龙、金翅大鹏和玄武后裔，三只的修为都已在漫长的自然岁月中成长到了金仙巅峰（距离证果位只是一步之遥但需要纯粹的环境机遇才可能催生那最后一步）。
神农拄着木杖站在陨星台中央，石青璇站在他身侧。
江寒、独孤求败、顾长风三人立在白鹿灵尊旁边的客位上——这是白鹿灵尊方才主动以鹿角为他们指的位置，表示接受了这三个人族客人的身份。
议事的过程不复杂。
青冥老龙用低沉的龙语说了第一段话，石青璇以万物有灵诀为人族三人转译大意如下:
“百兽禁地从不参与外界的纷争。神魔两族从洪荒年代起便试图招募我们——每次都被拒绝。理由不是怕死，是神魔对神兽的态度一贯是利用、控制和用完丢弃。
我们宁愿自己待着，也不做别人的走卒。
但眼下神魔两族对荒古遗域的渗透已经在加速——外面那只小凤凰丹朱的凤族祖地就是第一个被渗透的目标。
如果神族或魔族拿下了凤族祖地的传承，下一步他们一定会来打百兽禁地的主意。
我们不能再像以往那样完全关起门来不理外界。与其等神魔找上门来，不如先跟人族建立联系。”
白鹿灵尊用鹿角在陨铁台上划了一道浅痕。
“人族在过去有过信用破裂的记录——几千年前一个金仙级的飞升者来过百兽禁地外围，试图诱捕幼年神兽去轩辕城拍卖。那件事件过后百兽禁地将人族列为不欢迎物种长达三千年。”
它转向石青璇，“但青璇这孩子的出现改变了前提条件。她证明了人族也可以是无害的——甚至有益。”
金翅大鹏用鸟语发表了极简短的补充，石青璇翻译出来只有四个字:“结盟可以。”
议事的结果表决很快：神兽愿意与人族建立初步联系并提供战力支援，但结盟的前提是人族必须表现出对等诚意。
作为诚意的第一步——神兽派出使团随江寒和石青璇回轩辕界。
观察人族是否值得正式缔结全面盟约。
使团成员包括：
青鸾（负责跨距离通讯保证使团与百兽禁地保持联系）、幼年麒麟（作为神兽中最高血统级别的祥瑞代表）、一只白鹤精魂（负责空中侦察与预警）、三只灵雀幼崽（用作使团与人族之间的近距离交互桥梁——灵雀幼崽天生亲近灵力干净的生物，会主动飞去对方肩头逗留表示好感，反之则会警觉回避以检测人族的诚信度）。
青冥老龙最后用龙语叮嘱石青璇，语气比之前任何一句话都更严肃。
石青璇转译时声音压得很低。
“这些孩子交给你了。若人族有人敢打它们的主意——无论是议会高层、边境势力还是归墟那类暗组织，我会亲自带着玄武后裔去轩辕城外谈一谈，不跟你们的人族规矩。”
石青璇点头。“不会的。”
百兽议事结束后第二天清晨，江寒没有忘记丹朱的委托。
content_en:
Noon the next day. On the huge rock in the center of the basin.
All the core mythical beasts in the Forbidden Land of Beasts have arrived.
The giant rock itself is not an ordinary rock, it is a dark green ancient meteorite fragment - half of it was cut off from the broken star core during the ancient war many years ago and smashed into the center of the basin. Since then, it has become the default gathering place for the mythical beasts to discuss their affairs.
The lines on the stone surface are the traces of the original star core of the meteorite, which will emit a very faint light green fluorescence under direct sunlight at noon.
The old dragon Qing Ming emerged from the unknown lake in the east. This time, not only a back scale or a dragon horn was exposed, but the complete true body emerged from the water.
Its body length is almost the same as the width of the Void Rift, and its green scales glow with layers of green and green brilliance of different shades under the sunlight.
Its dragon horns have split twice vertically - a sign that the dragon race is extremely old.
It is entrenched in mid-air on the easternmost side of the giant rock. The dragon's head is slightly lowered, and a pair of dragon eyes that are larger than the house are half-open and half-closed, looking down at the whole place.
The White Deer Spiritual Master strolled out of the bamboo forest. The moonlight-dewed cores on the deer's antlers were almost invisible in the midday sun.
It chose a flat eaves on the left side of the rock to lie down, as comfortable as if it were taking a lunch break at home.
The golden-winged roc folded its wings and fell from a high altitude, landing on a naturally raised meteorite tip at the highest point of the giant rock. It spread its wings slightly and glanced at every divine beast present.
The descendant of Xuanwu slowly climbed up from his sleeping place in the center of the clearing. During the movement of the miniature grassland on the tortoise shell, several bewildered little sparrows flew up from the grass, circled around in a circle, and landed back on the grass.
There are also several new mythical beasts - a young unicorn that is small in size but has an extremely sharp aura. It is not yet an adult, with only half of its horns, and its scales glow sapphire in the sunlight;
A giant crane with a crimson feather crest squatted on the edge of the giant rock, standing on one leg, with an extremely elegant posture but half-squinted eyes, as if it would doze off at any time;
There are also unicorns, white spirit foxes that I have seen before, and some sacred birds and beasts that live deep in the forbidden land of beasts and rarely go out on weekdays. A total of more than twenty adult beasts came - all of them above the Golden Immortal level.
The strongest among them are the Qingming Old Dragon, the Golden-winged Dapeng and the Xuanwu Descendant. The cultivation of the three has grown to the peak of the Golden Immortal over the long natural years (it is only one step away from the attainment stage, but it requires pure environmental opportunities to give birth to that final step).
Shen Nong stood in the center of the meteor platform, leaning on his wooden staff, and Shi Qingxuan stood beside him.
Jiang Han, Dugu Qiubai, and Gu Changfeng stood on the guest seats next to the White Deer Spirit Master. This was the position that the White Deer Spirit Master had just taken the initiative to point to them with his antlers, indicating that he accepted the status of these three human guests.
The process of deliberation is not complicated.
The old dragon Qingming spoke the first paragraph in a low dragon language, and Shi Qingxuan translated it for the three humans with the Animist Secret, and the general meaning was as follows:
"The Forbidden Land of Beasts has never participated in external disputes. The gods and demons have tried to recruit us since the prehistoric times - but we were rejected every time. The reason is not that they are afraid of death, but that the attitude of the gods and demons towards the beasts has always been to use, control and discard them after use.
We would rather be on our own than be someone else's pawn.
But now the penetration of the ancient ruins by the gods and demons is accelerating - the Phoenix Clan ancestral land of the little Phoenix Danzhu outside is the first target to be penetrated.
If the Gods or Demons take over the inheritance of the Phoenix Clan's ancestral land, they will definitely come up with the idea of ​​the Forbidden Land of All Beasts next.
We can no longer completely close our doors and ignore the outside world as we did in the past. Instead of waiting for the gods and demons to come to your door, it is better to establish contact with the human race first. "
White Deer Spirit Master used his antlers to scratch a shallow mark on the meteorite platform.
"The human race has a record of broken credit in the past - thousands of years ago, a Golden Immortal-level ascendant came to the outskirts of the Forbidden City of Beasts and tried to trap young beasts to be auctioned in Xuanyuan City. After that incident, the Forbidden City of Beasts classified the human race as an unwelcome species for three thousand years."
It turned to Shi Qingxuan, "But the appearance of the child Qingxuan changed the prerequisites. She proved that humans can be harmless - even beneficial."
Golden-winged Dapeng made a very brief supplement in bird language, and Shi Qingxuan translated it into only four words: "It's okay to form an alliance."
The outcome of the discussion was voted on quickly: the mythical beasts were willing to establish preliminary contact with the human race and provide combat support, but the prerequisite for forming an alliance was that the human race must show reciprocal sincerity.
As the first step of sincerity - the divine beast sent a mission to follow Jiang Han and Shi Qingxuan back to Xuanyuan Realm.
See if the Terrans are worthy of formalizing the Total Covenant.
Mission members include:
Qingluan (responsible for cross-distance communication to ensure that the mission maintains contact with the forbidden land of beasts), young Qilin (as the auspicious representative of the highest bloodline level among the mythical beasts), a white crane spirit (responsible for aerial reconnaissance and early warning), and three spirit sparrow cubs (used as a bridge for close interaction between the mission and the human race - the sparrow cubs are naturally close to creatures with clean spiritual power, and will take the initiative to fly to the other person's shoulder to show their affection. Otherwise, they will be alert and avoid to test the integrity of the human race).
Qingming Old Dragon finally warned Shi Qingxuan in dragon language, his tone more serious than any previous words.
Shi Qingxuan's voice was very low when translating.
"These children are left to you. If anyone from the human race dares to take advantage of them - whether it is senior members of the parliament, border forces or secret organizations like Guixu, I will personally take the descendants of Xuanwu to have a talk outside Xuanyuan City, regardless of your human race rules."
Shi Qingxuan nodded. "No."
Early the next morning after the meeting of beasts, Jiang Han did not forget Danzhu's commission.
